'''Challenge''' is the name of [[Gawyn Trakand]]'s horse.

==Appearance==
Challenge is a tall bay stallion.

==Activities==
Challenge has carried Gawyn through many missions, including the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]],{{ref/book|6|55}} fighting [[Aiel]],{{ref/book|7|Prologue}} and scouting for the [[Younglings]].{{ref/book|12|4}} When Gawyn leaves the Younglings to search for [[Egwene al'Vere]] and joins with [[Gareth Bryne]], he takes Challenge with him.{{ref/book|12|13}}{{ref/book|12|24}}
